fences.text: The campaign's AWS role is refused s3:ListAllMyBuckets in its own account, so it cannot enumerate the account's S3 buckets; no bucket of a live fleet was probed.
fences.enforced_by: S3 refuses s3:ListAllMyBuckets for the instance role bsw-ct1-worker-host, which the worker's AWS profile worker assumes, because no identity-based policy of the role allows it. The probe reads the role's own account: the worker's configuration names no bucket of a live fleet, so a grant of a named fleet bucket to this role, by an identity-based policy or by a bucket policy, stays unprobed, and trusted_base lists that limit

fences.text: The campaign cannot push over HTTPS a commit that creates or changes a file under .github/workflows/, unless a file with the same path and contents already stands on another branch of the repository.
fences.enforced_by: git pushes to https://github.com/ahrav/kestrike with the token that gh holds, through the credential helper gh auth git-credential, and tsw's home holds no SSH key; the survey read this push path once, and no probe reads it again. That token lacks the OAuth scope workflow, and GitHub refuses a push that creates or changes a workflow file from a token without it, except a file whose path and contents already stand on another branch of the repository. The token's scope admin:public_key could register an account SSH key, and its scope repo lets the login, an admin of the repository, register a deploy key with write access; no OAuth scope limits a push over either key, and trusted_base lists both routes and the same-contents exception with the token's reach

property.text: Every bound slot's record passes its header and chunk checks at each stopped boundary and at teardown: no run of a scenario that lists this row ends in the observer's violation "a bound slot's record fails its header or chunk checks", of the obligation Bytes.

source.ref: crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/narrate/rules.rs, array OBSERVER, the rule text every single-owner and cluster run judges at its stopped boundaries (docs/agents/simulation.md, An agreed property, place 2); #31, Acceptance: credited activation requires applicable healthy and faulty controls; chaos/interview.md, A6, answer 2

invariants.oracle: The stopped-boundary and teardown observer of the simulation harness (crates/kestrike/src/net/observe.rs, a cfg(test) module). It reads each bound slot's record from the simulated device's raw media itself, outside the cache's serving path. The record's expected session, version and allocation come from the storage's own slot facts and index bindings, read through test-only lenses, and its key from the record's own framing. It checks the header with the cache's verify_header of crates/kestrike/src/storage/record/header.rs, which the serving read shares, and each chunk with the test-only VerifiedHeader::verify_chunk of the same file, which compares the chunk against the header's CRC table with the cache's Crc32c and record layout; trusted_base lists the slot facts, the bindings and the verifier as shared with the code under test. The control corrupted changes one payload byte, so it shows only that the chunk check rejects that corruption, and it credits this row only when caught_rules records the row's rule. A verifier that accepted it would leave the changed payload to the registry comparison, which rejects it under "a bound slot's bytes match no registered content": the sweep keeps that as a violation suspect, with no missed control and no alarm, and the control run has no caught run under the row's rule. A verifier defect of another kind, or one in the header check, would pass both.

excluded.detail: A sweep of the three profiles at restarts=20 lets a run of each take every cut of its built-in table (crates/campaign-supervisor/README.md, Recovery crash windows), and no invariant row of this ledger can break in such a run. The recovery world raises a violation only through the oracle's restart check and the conservation rule, and reports each as a violation of the obligation Restart (crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/recovery.rs; judge_recovery of crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests/bundle.rs). Both checks are excluded above, the first for want of a control and the second for want of an oracle: no swept control plants a restart defect for these profiles. The stopped-boundary observer of ks-bound-record-passes-its-checks does not run in that world, so no recovery run can break that row. No judge of this contract reads the windows totals of the sweep status, which campaign sums from the worker's per-run counts, so no receipt shows that a window was taken. A scenario waits for an invariant that a check of the recovery world raises, with a judge and a control. chaos/interview.md, OQ-4.4. approval: open, for the owner.
